overview_description.description: FanTV enables creators to produce and monetize digital media using AI agents within a Web3 ecosystem. The platform supports the creation of videos, music, podcasts, web series, and vlogs via simple prompts, and allows creators to earn through engagement, creator tokens, and decentralized monetization mechanisms. Built on blockchain technology—originally on Polygon and now deployed on the Sui network—it supports over 8 million on-chain wallets, 80,000 creators, and has processed more than 30 million content transactions.
